property_summary: After calling owned() by the current owner, the owner state variable remains unchanged.
The owner state variable can only be changed by the current owner through transferOwnership.
After calling owned(), the owner state variable is unchanged from its previous value.
After calling owned(), the owner remains unchanged.
After calling owned(), the owner remains the same as before the call.
Calling owned() with an arbitrary msg.sender never changes the owner.
After calling owned() with any msg.sender, the owner address remains the same as the original deployer.
After calling owned() with any msg.sender, the owner remains the deployer address (the original owner at setup).
